name: Common-password list: top 100,000 of the ten-million-password set (SecLists), modified
why: src/Platform/Yojana.Platform/Security/common-passwords-100k.txt is a copy of https://github.com/danielmiessler/SecLists/blob/c205c36a445bff37f8e58a9ec829105cd4975c58/Passwords/Common-Credentials/xato-net-10-million-passwords-100000.txt (source sha256 1472aafa2561df5e3293aee252aee3ca660c12b399a283cf808bb01b39be388b) with five lines removed (copy sha256 3c8b25eb988155db0295503e9c360dfe1f34e7e5606ab4a6abe5bd4acb823d71, 99,995 lines): the removed entries are other software vendors' brand names, which the product source may not contain. It is embedded in Yojana.Platform and used only to refuse common passwords (ADR-0008). The underlying data is Mark Burnett's ten-million-password set, which he announced on 9 February 2015 he was "releasing to the public domain" (announcement copy: https://attrition.org/pipermail/infowarrior/2015-February/012042.html; original post https://xato.net/passwords/ten-million-passwords/). The SecLists collection that publishes the top-100,000 file is MIT-licensed; its notice is reproduced here.
